ayahs.2: Yeh aayaten hain roshan kitaab ki.
ayahs.3: Hum aap ke saamne Moosa aur Firaun ka saheeh waqia bayaan karte hain un logon ke liye jo imaan rakhte hain.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan Firaun ne zameen mein sarkashi kar rakhi thi aur wahan ke logon ko giroh giroh bana rakha tha aur un mein se ek firqa ko kamzor kar rakha tha aur un ke ladkon ko to zabh kar daalta tha aur un ki ladkiyon ko zinda chhod deta tha. Be-shak-o-shubha woh tha hi mufsidon mein se.
ayahs.5: Phir hamari chaahat hui ke hum un par karam farmaayen jinhein zameen mein behad kamzor kar diya gaya tha, aur hum unhi ko peshwa aur (zameen) ka waaris banaayen.
ayahs.6: Aur yeh bhi ke hum unhein zameen mein qudrat-o-ikhtiyaar den aur Firaun aur Haamaan aur un ke lashkaron ko woh dikhaayen jis se woh dar rahe hain.
ayahs.7: Hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki maan ko wahi ki ke ise doodh pilaati reh aur jab tujhe is ki nisbat koi khauf maloom ho to ise darya mein baha dena aur koi dar khauf ya ranj gham na karna, hum yaqeenan ise teri taraf lautaane wale hain aur ise apne Paighambaron mein banaane wale hain.
ayahs.8: Aakhir Firaun ke logon ne is bachche ko utha liya ke aakhirkar yehi bachcha un ka dushman hua aur un ke ranj ka baais bana, kuchh shak nahin ke Firaun aur Haamaan aur un ke lashkar the hi khatakaar.
ayahs.9: Aur Firaun ki biwi ne kaha yeh to meri aur teri aankhon ki thandak hai, ise qatl na karo, bahut mumkin hai ke yeh hamein koi faaida pahunchaaye ya hum ise apna hi beta bana len aur yeh log sha'oor hi na rakhte the.
ayahs.10: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki waalida ka dil be-qaraar ho gaya, qareeb thin ke is waqia ko bilkul zaahir kar detin agar hum un ke dil ko dhaaras na de dete yeh is liye ke woh yaqeen karne walon mein rahe.
ayahs.11: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki waalida ne is ki behen se kaha ke tu is ke peechhe peechhe ja, to woh ise door hi door se dekhti rahi aur Firauniyon ko is ka ilm bhi na hua.
ayahs.12: Un ke pahunchne se pehle hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) par daaiyon ka doodh haraam kar diya tha. Yeh kehne lagi ke kya main tumhein aisa gharaana bataaun jo is bachche ki tumhare liye parwarish kare aur hon bhi woh is bachche ke khair-khwah.
ayahs.13: Pas hum ne ise is ki maan ki taraf waapas pahunchaaya, taake is ki aankhen thandi rahen aur aazurda-khaatir na ho aur jaan le ke Allah Taala ka waada sachcha hai lekin aksar log nahin jaante.
ayahs.14: Aur jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) apni jawaani ko pahunch gaye aur poore tawana ho gaye hum ne unhein hikmat-o-ilm ata farmaaya, neki karne walon ko hum isi tarah badla diya karte hain.
ayahs.15: Aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ek aise waqt shehr mein aaye jabke shehr ke log ghaflat mein the. Yahan do shakhs ko ladte hue paaya, yeh ek to is ke rafeeqon mein se tha aur yeh doosra is ke dushmanon mein se, is ki qaum wale ne is ke khilaaf jo is ke dushmanon mein se tha is se faryaad ki, jis par Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne is ko mukka maara jis se woh mar gaya Moosa (alaihis salaam) kehne lage yeh to shaitaani kaam hai, yaqeenan shaitaan dushman aur khule taur par behkaane wala hai.
ayahs.16: Phir dua karne lage ke aye Parwardigar! Main ne khud apne upar zulm kiya, to mujhe maaf farma de, Allah Taala ne ise bakhsh diya, woh bakhshish aur bahut mehrbaani karne wala hai.
ayahs.17: Kehne lage aye mere Rabb! Jaise tu ne mujh par yeh karam farmaaya main bhi ab hargiz kisi gunahgaar ka madadgaar na banoonga.
ayahs.18: Subah hi subah darte andesha ki haalat mein khabren lene ko shehr mein gaye, ke achaanak wohi shakhs jis ne kal un se madad talab ki thi un se faryaad kar raha hai. Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne is se kaha ke is mein shak nahin tu to sareeh be-raah hai.
ayahs.19: Phir jab apne aur is ke dushman ko pakadna chaaha woh faryaadi kehne laga ke Moosa (alaihis salaam) kya jis tarah tu ne kal ek shakhs ko qatl kiya hai mujhe bhi maar daalna chaahta hai, tu to mulk mein zaalim-o-sarkash hona hi chaahta hai aur tera yeh iraada hi nahin ke milaap karne walon mein se ho.
ayahs.20: Shehr ke parle kinaare se ek shakhs daudta hua aaya aur kehne laga aye Moosa! Yahan ke sardaar tere qatl ka mashwara kar rahe hain, pas tu bahut jald chala ja mujhe apna khair-khwah maan.
ayahs.21: Pas Moosa (alaihis salaam) wahan se khaufzada ho kar dekhte bhaalte nikal khade hue, kehne lage aye Parwardigar! Mujhe zaalimon ke giroh se bacha le.
ayahs.22: Aur jab Madyan ki taraf mutawajjah hue to kehne lage mujhe umeed hai ke mera Rabb mujhe seedhi raah le chalega.
ayahs.23: Madyan ke paani par jab aap pahunche to dekha ke logon ki ek jamaat wahan paani pila rahi hai aur do auraten alag khadi apne (jaanwaron ko) rokti hui dikhaai din, poochha ke tumhara kya haal hai, woh bolin ke jab tak yeh charwaahe waapas na laut jaayen hum paani nahin pilaateen aur hamare waalid bahut badi umr ke boodhe hain.
ayahs.24: Pas aap ne khud un jaanwaron ko paani pila diya phir saaye ki taraf hat aaye aur kehne lage aye Parwardigar! Tu jo kuchh bhalaai meri taraf utaare main is ka mohtaaj hoon.
ayahs.25: Itne mein un donon auraton mein se ek un ki taraf sharm-o-haya se chalti hui aayi, kehne lagi ke mere baap aap ko bula rahe hain taake aap ne hamare (jaanwaron) ko jo paani pilaaya hai is ki ujrat den, jab Hazrat Moosa (alaihis salaam) un ke paas pahunche aur un se apna saara haal bayaan kiya to woh kehne lage ab na dar tu ne zaalim qaum se najaat paayi.
ayahs.26: Un donon mein se ek ne kaha ke Abba ji! Aap unhein mazdoori par rakh lijiye, kyunki jinhein aap ujrat par rakhen un mein se sab se behtar woh hai jo mazboot aur amaanatdaar ho.
ayahs.27: Is buzurg ne kaha main apni in donon ladkiyon mein se ek ko aap ke nikaah mein dena chaahta hoon is (mehar par) ke aap aath saal tak mera kaam kaaj karen. Haan agar aap das saal poore karen to yeh aap ki taraf se ba-taur-e-ehsaan ke hai main yeh hargiz nahin chaahta ke aap ko kisi mushaqqat mein daalun, Allah ko manzoor hai to aage chal kar aap mujhe bhala aadmi paayenge.
ayahs.28: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha, khair to yeh baat mere aur aap ke darmiyaan pukhta ho gayi, main un donon muddaton mein se jise poora karun mujh par koi ziyaadati na ho, hum yeh jo kuchh keh rahe hain is par Allah (gawah aur) karsaz hai.
ayahs.29: Jab Hazrat Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne muddat poori kar li aur apne ghar walon ko le kar chale to Koh-e-Toor ki taraf aag dekhi. Apni biwi se kehne lage thahro! Main ne aag dekhi hai bahut mumkin hai ke main wahan se koi khabar laaun ya aag ka koi angaara laaun taake tum senk lo.
ayahs.30: Pas jab wahan pahunche to is ba-barkat zameen ke maidan ke daayen kinaare ke darakht mein se awaaz diye gaye ke aye Moosa! Yaqeenan main hi Allah hoon saare jahaanon ka Parwardigar.
ayahs.31: Aur yeh (bhi awaaz aayi) ke apni laathi daal de. Phir jab ise dekha ke woh saanp ki tarah phan-phana rahi hai to peeth pher kar waapas ho gaye aur mud kar rukh bhi na kiya, hum ne kaha aye Moosa! Aage aa dar mat, yaqeenan tu har tarah aman wala hai.
ayahs.32: Apne haath ko apne girebaan mein daal woh baghair kisi qism ke rog ke chamakta hua niklega bilkul safed aur khauf se (bachne ke liye) apne baazu apni taraf mila le, pas yeh donon mojize tere liye tere Rabb ki taraf se hain Firaun aur is ki jamaat ki taraf, yaqeenan woh sab ke sab be-hukm aur nafarman log hain.
ayahs.33: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha Parwardigar! Main ne un ka ek aadmi qatl kar diya tha. Ab mujhe andesha hai ke woh mujhe bhi qatl kar daalen.
ayahs.34: Aur mera bhai Haaroon (alaihis salaam) mujh se bahut ziyaada faseeh zabaan wala hai to ise bhi mera madadgaar bana kar mere saath bhej ke woh mujhe sachcha maane, mujhe to khauf hai ke woh sab mujhe jhutla denge.
ayahs.35: Allah Taala ne farmaaya ke hum tere bhai ke saath tera baazu mazboot kar denge aur tum donon ko ghalba denge Firauni tum tak pahunch hi na sakenge, ba-sabab hamari nishaaniyon ke, tum donon aur tumhari taabedaari karne wale hi ghaalib rahenge.
ayahs.36: Pas jab un ke paas Moosa (alaihis salaam) hamare diye hue khule mojize le kar pahunche to woh kehne lage yeh to sirf ghada ghadaaya jaadu hai hum ne apne agle baap dadon ke zamaane mein kabhi yeh nahin suna.
ayahs.37: Hazrat Moosa (alaihis salaam) kehne lage mera Rabb Taala ise khoob jaanta hai jo is ke paas ki hidayat le kar aata hai aur jis ke liye aakhirat ka (achchha) anjaam hota hai. Yaqeenan be-insaafon ka bhala na hoga.
ayahs.38: Firaun kehne laga aye darbaariyo! Main to apne siwa kisi ko tumhara mabood nahin jaanta. Sun aye Haamaan! Tu mere liye mitti ko aag se pakwa phir mere liye ek mahal taameer kar to main Moosa ke mabood ko jhaank loon ise main to jhooton mein se hi gumaan kar raha hoon.
ayahs.39: Is ne aur is ke lashkaron ne na-haq tareeqe par mulk mein takabbur kiya aur samajh liya ke woh hamari jaanib lautaaye hi na jaayenge.
ayahs.40: Bil-aakhir hum ne ise aur is ke lashkaron ko pakad liya aur darya-burd kar diya, ab dekh le ke in gunahgaaron ka anjaam kaisa kuchh hua?
ayahs.41: Aur hum ne unhein aise imam bana diye ke logon ko jahannam ki taraf bulaayen aur roz-e-qayamat mutlaq madad na kiye jaayen.
ayahs.42: Aur hum ne is dunya mein bhi un ke peechhe apni laanat laga di aur qayamat ke din bhi woh badhaal logon mein se honge.
ayahs.43: Aur un agle zamaane walon ko halaak karne ke baad hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko aisi kitaab inaayat farmaayi jo logon ke liye daleel aur hidayat-o-rahmat ho kar aayi thi taake woh naseehat haasil kar len.
ayahs.44: Aur Toor ke maghribi jaanib jab ke hum ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko hukm ahkaam ki wahi pahunchaayi thi, na to tu maujood tha aur na tu dekhne walon mein se tha.
ayahs.45: Lekin hum ne bahut si naslen paida keen jin par lambi muddaten guzar gayin, aur na tu Madyan ke rehne walon mein se tha ke un ke saamne hamari aayaton ki tilaawat karta balke hum hi Rasoolon ke bhejne wale rahe.
ayahs.46: Aur na tu Toor ki taraf tha jab ke hum ne awaaz di balke yeh tere Parwardigar ki taraf se ek rahmat hai, is liye ke tu un logon ko hoshiyaar kar de jin ke paas tujh se pehle koi daraane wala nahin pahuncha, kya ajab ke woh naseehat haasil kar len.
ayahs.47: Agar yeh baat na hoti ke unhein un ke apne haathon aage bheje hue aamaal ki wajah se koi museebat pahunchti to yeh keh uthte ke aye hamare Rabb! Tu ne hamari taraf koi Rasool kyun na bheja? Ke hum teri aayaton ki taabedaari karte aur imaan walon mein se ho jaate.
ayahs.48: Phir jab un ke paas hamari taraf se haq aa pahuncha to kehte hain ke yeh woh kyun nahin diya gaya jaise diye gaye the Moosa (alaihis salaam) achchha to kya Moosa (alaihis salaam) ko jo kuchh diya gaya tha is ke saath logon ne kufr nahin kiya tha, saaf kaha tha ke yeh donon jaadugar hain jo ek doosre ke madadgaar hain aur hum to in sab ke munkir hain.
ayahs.49: Keh de ke agar sachche ho to tum bhi Allah ke paas se koi aisi kitaab le aao jo in donon se ziyaada hidayat wali ho main isi ki pairwi karoonga.
ayahs.50: Phir agar yeh teri na maanen to tu yaqeen kar le ke yeh sirf apni khwahish ki pairwi kar rahe hain. Aur is se badh kar behka hua kaun hai? Jo apni khwahish ke peechhe pada hua ho baghair Allah ki rehnumaai ke, beshak Allah Taala zaalim logon ko hidayat nahin deta.
ayahs.51: Aur hum baraabar pe-dar-pe logon ke liye apna kalaam bhejte rahe taake woh naseehat haasil kar len.
ayahs.52: Jis ko hum ne is se pehle kitaab inaayat farmaayi woh to is par bhi imaan rakhte hain.
ayahs.53: Aur jab is ki aayaten un ke paas padhi jaati hain to woh keh dete hain ke is ke hamare Rabb ki taraf se haq hone par hamara imaan hai hum to is se pehle hi musalman hain.
ayahs.54: Yeh apne kiye hue sabr ke badle dohra dohra ajr diye jaayenge. Yeh neki se badi ko taal dete hain aur hum ne jo unhein de rakha hai is mein se dete rehte hain.
ayahs.55: Aur jab behooda baat kaan mein padti hai to is se kinaara kar lete hain aur keh dete hain ke hamare amal hamare liye aur tumhare aamaal tumhare liye, tum par salaam ho, hum jaahilon se (ulajhna) nahin chaahte.
ayahs.56: Aap jise chaahen hidayat nahin kar sakte balke Allah Taala hi jise chaahe hidayat karta hai. Hidayat walon se wohi khoob aagaah hai.
ayahs.57: Kehne lage agar hum aap ke saath ho kar hidayat ke taabedaar ban jaayen to hum to apne mulk se uchak liye jaayen, kya hum ne unhein aman-o-amaan aur hurmat wale haram mein jagah nahin di? Jahan tamaam cheezon ke phal khinche chale aate hain jo hamare paas ba-taur-e-rizq ke hain, lekin un mein se aksar kuchh nahin jaante.
ayahs.58: Aur hum ne bahut si woh bastiyan tabaah kar din jo apni aish-o-ishrat mein itraane lagi thin, yeh hain un ki rehaish ki jagahen jo un ke baad bahut hi kam aabaad ki gayin aur hum hi hain aakhir sab kuchh ke waaris.
ayahs.59: Tera Rabb kisi ek basti ko bhi is waqt tak halaak nahin karta jab tak ke un ki kisi badi basti mein apna koi Paighambar na bhej de jo unhein hamari aayaten padh kar suna de aur hum bastiyon ko isi waqt halaak karte hain jab ke wahan wale zulm-o-sitam par kamar kas len.
ayahs.60: Aur tumhein jo kuchh diya gaya hai woh sirf zindagi-e-dunya ka saamaan aur isi ki raunaq hai, haan Allah ke paas jo hai woh bahut hi behtar aur derpa hai. Kya tum nahin samajhte.
ayahs.61: Kya woh shakhs jis se hum ne nek waada kiya hai jise woh qatan paane wala hai misl is shakhs ke ho sakta hai? Jise hum ne zindagani-e-dunya ki kuchh yunhi si manfa'at de di phir bil-aakhir woh qayamat ke roz pakda baandha haazir kiya jaayega.
ayahs.62: Aur jis din Allah Taala unhein pukaar kar farmaayega ke tum jinhein apne gumaan mein mera shareek thahra rahe the kahan hain.
ayahs.63: Jin par baat aa chuki woh jawab denge ke aye hamare Parwardigar! Yehi woh hain jinhein hum ne behka rakha tha, hum ne unhein isi tarah behkaaya jis tarah hum behke the, hum teri sarkaar mein apni dast-bardaari karte hain, yeh hamari ibaadat nahin karte the.
ayahs.64: Kaha jaayega ke apne shareekon ko bulaao, woh bulaayenge lekin unhein woh jawab tak na denge aur sab azaab dekh lenge, kaash yeh log hidayat pa lete.
ayahs.65: Is din unhein bula kar poochhega ke tum ne nabiyon ko kya jawab diya?
ayahs.66: Phir to is din un ki tamaam daleelen gum ho jaayengi aur ek doosre se sawaal tak na karenge.
ayahs.67: Haan jo shakhs tauba kar le imaan le aaye aur nek kaam kare yaqeen hai ke woh najaat paane walon mein se ho jaayega.
ayahs.68: Aur aap ka Rabb jo chaahta hai paida karta hai aur jise chaahta hai chun leta hai, un mein se kisi ko koi ikhtiyaar nahin, Allah hi ke liye paaki hai woh buland-tar hai har is cheez se ke log shareek karte hain.
ayahs.69: Un ke seene jo kuchh chhupaate aur jo kuchh zaahir karte hain aap ka Rabb sab kuchh jaanta hai.
ayahs.70: Wohi Allah hai is ke siwa koi laaiq-e-ibaadat nahin, dunya aur aakhirat mein isi ki taareef hai. Isi ke liye farmanrawaai hai aur isi ki taraf tum sab phere jaaoge.
ayahs.71: Keh dijiye! Ke dekho to sahi agar Allah Taala tum par raat hi raat qayamat tak baraabar kar de to siwaaye Allah ke kaun mabood hai jo tumhare paas din ki roshni laaye? Kya tum sunte nahin ho?
ayahs.72: Poochhiye! Ke yeh bhi bata do ke agar Allah Taala tum par hamesha qayamat tak din hi din rakhe to bhi siwaaye Allah Taala ke koi mabood hai jo tumhare paas raat le aaye? Jis mein tum aaraam haasil karo, kya tum dekh nahin rahe ho?
ayahs.73: Isi ne to tumhare liye apne fazl-o-karam se din raat muqarrar kar diye hain ke tum raat mein aaraam karo aur din mein is ki bheji hui rozi talaash karo, yeh is liye ke tum shukr ada karo.
ayahs.74: Aur jis din unhein pukaar kar Allah Taala farmaayega ke jinhein tum mere shareek khayaal karte the woh kahan hain?
ayahs.75: Aur hum har ummat mein se ek gawah alag kar lenge ke apni daleelen pesh karo pas is waqt jaan lenge ke haq Allah Taala ki taraf hai, aur jo kuchh iftira woh jodte the sab un ke paas se kho jaayega.
ayahs.76: Qaroon tha to qaum-e-Moosa se, lekin un par zulm karne laga tha hum ne ise (is qadr) khazane de rakhe the ke kai kai taaqatwar log ba-mushkil is ki kunjiyan utha sakte the, ek baar is ki qaum ne is se kaha ke itra mat! Allah Taala itraane walon se mohabbat nahin rakhta.
ayahs.77: Aur jo kuchh Allah Taala ne tujhe de rakha hai is mein se aakhirat ke ghar ki talaash bhi rakh aur apne dunyawi hisse ko bhi na bhool aur jaise ke Allah ne tere saath ehsaan kiya hai tu bhi achchha sulook kar aur mulk mein fasaad ka khwahan na ho, yaqeen maan ke Allah mufsidon ko na-pasand rakhta hai.
ayahs.78: Qaroon ne kaha yeh sab kuchh mujhe meri apni samajh ki bina par hi diya gaya hai, kya ise ab tak yeh nahin maloom ke Allah Taala ne is se pehle bahut se basti walon ko ghaarat kar diya jo is se bahut ziyaada quwwat wale aur bahut badi jama-poonji wale the. Aur gunahgaaron se un ke gunaahon ki baaz-purs aise waqt nahin ki jaati.
ayahs.79: Pas Qaroon poori aaraish ke saath apni qaum ke majme mein nikla, to dunyawi zindagi ke matwaale kehne lage kaash ke hamein bhi kisi tarah woh mil jaata jo Qaroon ko diya gaya hai. Yeh to bada hi qismat ka dhani hai.
ayahs.80: Zi-ilm log unhein samjhaane lage ke afsos! Behtar cheez to woh hai jo ba-taur-e-sawaab unhein milegi jo Allah par imaan laayein aur nek amal karen yeh baat unhi ke dil mein daali jaati hai jo sabr-o-sahaara wale hon.
ayahs.81: (Aakhirkar) hum ne ise is ke mahal samet zameen mein dhansa diya aur Allah ke siwa koi jamaat is ki madad ke liye tayyaar na hui na woh khud apne bachaane walon mein se ho saka.
ayahs.82: Aur jo log kal is ke martaba par pahunchne ki aarzoo-mandiyan kar rahe the woh aaj kehne lage ke kya tum nahin dekhte ke Allah Taala hi apne bandon mein se jis ke liye chaahe rozi kushaada kar deta hai aur tang bhi? Agar Allah Taala hum par fazl na karta to hamein bhi dhansa deta, kya dekhte nahin ho ke na-shukron ko kabhi kaamyaabi nahin hoti?
ayahs.83: Aakhirat ka yeh bhala ghar hum unhi ke liye muqarrar kar dete hain jo zameen mein oonchaai badaai aur fakhr nahin karte na fasaad ki chaahat rakhte hain. Parhezgaaron ke liye nihaayat hi umda anjaam hai.
ayahs.84: Jo shakhs neki laayega ise is se behtar milega aur jo buraai le kar aayega to aise bad-aamaali karne walon ko un ke unhi aamaal ka badla diya jaayega jo woh karte the.
ayahs.85: Jis Allah ne aap par Quran naazil farmaaya hai woh aap ko dobaara pehli jagah laane wala hai, keh dijiye! Ke mera Rabb ise bhi bakhoobi jaanta hai jo hidayat laaya hai aur ise bhi jo khuli gumraahi mein hai.
ayahs.86: Aap ko to kabhi is ka khayaal bhi na guzra tha ke aap ki taraf kitaab naazil farmaayi jaayegi lekin yeh aap ke Rabb ki mehrbaani se utra. Ab aap ko hargiz kaafiron ka madadgaar na hona chaahiye.
ayahs.87: Khayaal rakhiye ke yeh kuffar aap ko Allah Taala ki aayaton ki tableegh se rok na den is ke baad ke yeh aap ki jaanib utaari gayin, to apne Rabb ki taraf bulaate rahen aur shirk karne walon mein se na hon.
ayahs.88: Allah Taala ke saath kisi aur mabood ko na pukaarna bajuz Allah Taala ke koi aur mabood nahin, har cheez fana hone wali hai magar isi ka munh (aur zaat). Isi ke liye farmanrawaai hai aur tum isi ki taraf lautaaye jaaoge.
